units.rawText: A long time ago, boxing was free and unrestrained. People used their fists to vent their adrenaline and the bestial instincts lurking deep in their hearts.

units.rawText: Once the tiger springs free of its cage, everything becomes so simple.

units.rawText: I used to be the same way too, expressing myself in a clash of sweat and blood, even forgetting that I was just a Doll.
